items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Jack Pearl, Harry Richman... I can't think of nobody else.

ctx.x: Well, just in case we didn't mention it, who were some of the performers that were at the Ziegfeld Follies when you were there?
Hal Leroy, Mitzi Mayfair, Jack Pearl, Harry Richman, Frank and Mill Britton's Band, Helen Morgan, Faith Bacon -- I can't think of nobody else.
Okay. Nonetheless you still just performed with Buck, you didn't perform with any of these people.
